assumptions_made: Outcome window default: 60 minutes, configurable via OUTCOME_WINDOW_MINUTES env var — PROVISIONAL, not backtested.
Recording trigger: once per new verdict episode (verdict change), not on every ~3-min poll and not tied to Haiku's 15-min re-fire.
Minimum sample size before a per-signal stat is shown: 5 — PROVISIONAL floor, not backtested.

Journal cross-reference by tradingDate (not a literal read-from-Journal trigger) — chosen because JournalEntry lacks the entry/SL/T1/T2/signal-contribution data the Outcome Engine needs to function; a literal integration would have broken its core purpose.
known_limitations_disclosed_in_code: Records live in memory only — reset on Railway redeploy (same disclosed pattern as Recorder Engine).

Outcome matching depends on the Recorder Engine's per-snapshot ATM CE/PE premium; if the ATM strike shifts away before the window completes, the record is marked INCOMPLETE_STRIKE_SHIFTED rather than guessed.
No Probability Engine — correctly out of scope for this task.
